description: This file defines CKEditor 5 font plugin components, including font size, family, color, background color, and related UI and command classes. It manages font styling features for the editor.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Base class for font attribute commands, allowing setting and removing font attributes.

classes.name: FontSize
classes.description: Plugin class managing font size attribute, including UI and conversion logic.

classes.name: FontFamily
classes.description: Plugin class managing font family attribute, including UI and conversion logic.

classes.name: FontColor
classes.description: Plugin class managing font color attribute, including UI and conversion logic.

classes.name: FontBackgroundColor
classes.description: Plugin class managing font background color attribute, including UI and conversion logic.

classes.name: FontSizeUI
classes.description: UI component for selecting font size.

classes.name: FontFamilyUI
classes.description: UI component for selecting font family.

classes.name: FontColorUI
classes.description: UI component for selecting font color.

classes.name: FontBackgroundColorUI
classes.description: UI component for selecting font background color.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Update command state based on current selection.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Apply or remove font attribute in the editor.

methods.name: _prepareAnyValueConverters
methods.description: Configure conversion for arbitrary font size values.

methods.name: _prepareCompatibilityConverter
methods.description: Set up conversion for legacy font attribute formats.

methods.name: _getLocalizedOptions
methods.description: Retrieve localized font options for UI.
